code:
model.eval()
total_loss, total_tokens = 0.0, 0

with torch.no_grad():
    for x, y in val_loader:
        logits = model(x)
        loss = F.cross_entropy(
            logits.reshape(-1, V),
            y.reshape(-1),
            reduction="sum")
        total_loss += loss.item()
        total_tokens += y.numel()
caption: eval() disables dropout; no_grad() skips gradient bookkeeping.

code:
import math

perplexity = math.exp(
    total_loss / total_tokens
)

# reduction="sum" + manual divide
# weights every token equally,
# even across uneven batch sizes
